title: Hearing on the city's new Office of Community Safety
summary: The Council's Public Safety and Governmental Operations committees will examine the Office of Community Safety, created by Mayor Mamdani's March 2026 executive order to coordinate the city's non-police violence prevention and crisis response programs. The hearing will also cover three related bills: one to create a permanent Department of Community Safety, one to set up a three-digit gun violence intervention hotline, and one to let people do community service instead of paying fines for illegal dumping.
